_source: Static UI keys for the mobile resident repair-tracking screen (route srv-track, pototype/mobile-screens.jsx MSrvTrack L125-192). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS (the approvals_inbox / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent): fields listed as dict below are stable ids read with t(); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). MOSTLY ZERO-MINT: the 5 timeline labels are byte-identical to the dict keys the MERGED WEB after-sales port already renders for the same state machine — statusReceived=sales.service.statusReceived 'รับเรื่อง' (L141), statusScheduled=sales.service.statusScheduled 'นัดช่าง' (L142), statusFixing=sales.service.statusFixing 'กำลังซ่อม' (L143, also the pill on L137), statusFixed=sales.service.statusFixed 'ซ่อมเสร็จ' (L144), statusClosed=sales.service.statusClosed 'ปิดงาน' (L145) — each verified byte-exact against the raw .jsx this round. warrantyLeft=sales.service.detailWarrantyLeft 'Warranty คงเหลือ' is the same label the web detail uses for the same server-derived number (L185, minus the mock's inline colon — this port draws label and value as the prototype's own space-between row, so no punctuation is appended to a translated string). warrantyDelivered=sales.process.legendDelivered 'ส่งมอบ' matches L182 the same way. monthsSuffix=sales.service.monthsSuffix 'เดือน' renders the whole-month count (the prototype's extra '30 วัน' has no wire — the server returns months). THREE values are net-new and are staged in agents/orch-d-recon/service-group-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is UNTOUCHED by this slice): eyebrow 'ลูกบ้าน' (L128), title 'ติดตามแจ้งซ่อม' (L128), historyTitle 'ประวัติการซ่อม' (L161). All three already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th — the pm_jobs / st_grlist / notif / approve / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. See BLOCKERS.md B-292. NOT REPRESENTED HERE: (1) the warranty card's own title 'Warranty ยูนิต B-08' (L180) is OMITTED, not keyed — it embeds a unit CODE this app cannot resolve (unit_id is a project_node uuid with no label endpoint; the merged web port em-dashes the same field), and minting the fragment 'Warranty ยูนิต' would be inventing copy that appears nowhere in the prototype; (2) the history rows' star rating (L163-165) is DROPPED — service_ticket has no rating column and the close handler's own comment says that round did not invent one (apps/api/src/routes/sales-service.ts L354-356), so there is no label and no value; (3) the ticket line's unit segment ('B-08', L135) renders as an em-dash beside the REAL stored category.
